user.title: Set up Hearth
user.description: Your household's Hearth TVs, phones and tablets pair with Home Assistant from their own settings (on a TV: Settings > Home Assistant > Pair with Home Assistant). Each one that asks shows up here to confirm.

confirm.title: Pair {name}?
confirm.description:
Check that {name} shows this code:

**{code}**

Pair it only if the codes match. A device you don't recognize, or a code that doesn't match, may be someone else's: close this instead.

data_description.person: For a phone or tablet: the person it belongs to. Its screen time counts for them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. TVs and phones pair from their own settings.
abort.expired: This request has ended. Ask again from the TV or phone.

menu_options.group_apps: Add apps to Video or Games

people.title: Who's who on the TVs
people.description: Each Google TV profile the household's TVs have reported, and the person it is. Leave a guest or shared profile empty: its time counts for nobody. A profile not listed (nobody used it today) can be added below by its id, as the TV's Hearth shows it (user:11).

add_group.title: Add a group
add_group.description: A group's apps count together against one budget, on every device. For example YouTube: YouTube and HearthTube.

group_apps.title: Add apps to Video or Games
group_apps.description: Apps Android marks as video or games are in these already. Add the ones it misses.

remove_group.title: Remove a group
remove_group.description: Its budgets and bonuses go with it.

add_source.title: Add a screen time source
add_source.description: Another integration's sensor: time today (Family Link's Daily Screen Time, Family Safety's Screen Time, Nintendo's Used screen time), or, with Live on, what's being played now (Xbox's Now playing, a Switch presence Game sensor), which Hearth times itself. If it's the same device as a Hearth device or another source, say so: its minutes are then counted once.

data.name: Name
data.live: Live: it says what's being played now

data_description.group: For time it can't put on an app: Games for a Switch or Xbox.

add_title.title: Add a title
add_title.description: One game or app by every name it has: the Android package, its name on Xbox and Switch, the PC app. Its time is counted together, and people on it at the same time are playing together.

locks.title: Locks
locks.description: Sensors that are on while this person may not watch, such as Family Link's bedtime and school time ones. While any is on, the person's Hearth devices hold their apps. Choosing a person again replaces their locks; none clears them.

new_apps.title: Watch for new apps
new_apps.description: Apps the kids start using on Hearth's devices are noticed by themselves. Add sensors that list a kid's allowed apps (Family Link's Apps without limits and Apps with time limits) to notice an app as soon as it's allowed. A phone, if chosen, is asked which group each new app counts in.

sort_apps.title: Sort new apps
sort_apps.description: The group each new app counts in. Other: only All screen time. Leave one empty to sort it later.

school_days.title: School days
school_days.description: Which budget applies today: the school-day one or the other-day one. Give any mix of these; the first that answers decides: the dates below, then the entity, then the calendar, then Monday to Friday within the school year.

data.entity: An entity that says what today is
data.school_states: Its states that mean a school day
data.keywords: Only events whose title has one of these words
data.year_start: First day of the school year
data.year_end: Last day of the school year

data_description.entity: A helper an automation keeps, the Workday integration's sensor, an input_boolean. Unavailable passes the question on.
data_description.school_states: Separated by commas. Leave empty for on, school, true, yes.
data_description.keywords: Separated by commas, for a calendar of days off: closed, break, holiday. Empty: any event.
data_description.days_off: Dates (2026-11-26) or ranges (2026-12-24..2027-01-01), separated by commas or new lines.
data_description.extra_school_days: Same, for days that are school days although they'd be off.

error.already_added: That sensor is a source already.
error.bad_profile_id: Give an id like user:11, and its person.

abort.no_profiles: No TV has reported its profiles yet. Pair a TV and let it post its status first.
abort.no_groups: There are no groups of your own to remove.

add_bonus.name: Add a bonus
add_bonus.description: Adds minutes to a person's budget for today (a negative number takes them away).

group.name: Group
group.description: The group's id: all, video, games, or one of your own.

set_budget.name: Set a budget
set_budget.description: Sets a person's daily budget for a group, on school days, other days, or both. Leave minutes empty for no limit.

group.name: Group
group.description: The group's id: all, video, games, or one of your own.

days.name: Days
days.description: school_days, other_days, or both (weekday and weekend are older names for the first two).
